author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing treats a page number below 1 as the first page
summary: Requesting the owner listing with page 0 or any negative page shows the normal first page of results instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: [REQ-OWN-005] given a request for the owner listing naming page 0, when it is served, then the listing responds normally (HTTP 200) with the same result as page 1.
[REQ-OWN-005] given a request for the owner listing naming a negative page, when it is served, then the listing responds normally (HTTP 200) with the same result as page 1.
[REQ-OWN-005] edge case 4: an empty search with a page below 1 lists the first page of every owner.
non_goals: Non-numeric page values: the intake names only page values below 1
Page numbers beyond the last page of results
notes: Bug fix from intake line 1. Root diagnosis: the owner search subtracts 1 from the page number before building the page request, and a negative index throws. The three page cases (0, -1, and an empty search) form one behavior, so they belong in one data-driven test. The single-match redirect already follows from 'same result as page 1'. No Non-Goals row changed, no ubiquitous-language term added, no autofix records to audit.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by docs/architecture-principles.md § DDD building blocks, Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the page clamp belongs in OwnerController's owner search (grep basis, IDE oracle not connected: OwnerController.processFindForm binds page and findPaginatedForOwnersLastName builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize), which throws for page < 1). Normalize the page once, where it is bound in processFindForm, before both the query and addPaginationModel, so the rendered currentPage also reads 1 ('same result as page 1'). No new type, module, or pattern. The only design write is REQ-OWN-005 joining the OwnerController Contracts row.
integration_points: Framework transport: MockMvc drives the real MVC dispatch and binding for GET /owners?page=N (the sanctioned transport stand-in, CLAUDE.md Testing Strategy).

Repository boundary: the existing @MockitoBean OwnerRepository in OwnerControllerTests (tolerated existing double, the WebMvcTest slice loads no JPA); stub findByLastNameStartingWith with any(Pageable) and assert the request resolves to the first page (page index 0), following the existing Franklin stub.
Binding target: page stays a request-scoped int @RequestParam, clamped to a minimum of 1; no persisted type is bound for it.

patterns.ref: docs/architecture-principles.md § DDD building blocks (Web controller row and the deviation note)
patterns.description: A parameter's range or shape belongs to the request that carries it. A clamp is binding and is not a new controller business rule.

risks.risk: Clamping only the PageRequest index but not the page passed to addPaginationModel would render currentPage 0 or a negative value in the pager.
risks.mitigation: Normalize once at the top of processFindForm and use the normalized value for both calls (architecture-principles Web controller row).

risks.risk: Owner search paging scales with the number of owners. docs/system-design.md has no Scale and Load section and so no row for it.
risks.mitigation: The slice adds no path that scales with data and does not change the fixed page size or the query. Simplest readable form (Math.max(page, 1)).

notes: Six-verdict check: not foundational, because the design doc, ADRs, and vocabulary are populated and the slice touches no project-level concern without a pattern. Not conflicting, because the PRD non-goals (non-numeric pages, pages past the end, vet paging) exclude those cases, so VetController stays untouched. Out of scope: non-numeric page values still fail binding. No design-doc-autofix records to audit. Brief gap for a later owner: docs/system-design.md carries no § Scale and Load section; this slice adds no scaling path, so none is written here.

This is a new test (added in this diff), so the rule applies from the start.
findings.fix: Add a suite-level `anOwner()` default factory (an Owner whose fields are all irrelevant to this test) and use it in place of the bare `new Owner()` at line 173.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner listing page below 1 to the first page

blast_radius.note: One controller method in one module (OwnerController.processFindForm) gains a two-line clamp; the doc edits only add the REQ-OWN-005 anchor, prose, bullet, edge case, and Contracts-row citation. No sensitive paths; the security-surface flag on the controller is the page parameter itself.

semantic_surprise.note: Read the hunk and the whole method. The parameter was renamed to requestedPage but binds explicitly as name="page", so the request contract is unchanged. Math.max(requestedPage, 1) runs before both the query (PageRequest.of(page - 1, 5)) and addPaginationModel, so currentPage renders 1 and the template's prev/next links stay consistent. Pages of 1 or more pass through unchanged, Integer.MIN_VALUE is safe, and no guard was removed.

test_adequacy.note: A parameterized MockMvc test covers pages 0 and -1 and asserts HTTP 200, currentPage 1, the list view, and a repository call with page index 0 for the empty search. Before the fix PageRequest.of(-1, ...) throws, so the test would fail against the broken code. It does not cover a non-empty last name with a page below 1, but the clamp runs before the search branch, so that gap is not material.
